description: Construction of the New Cardiology Unit Building of the District General Hospital, Trincomalee and the New Cardiology and Cardiothoracic Complex Building at the Teaching Hospital, Anuradhapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Health and Medical Service Improvement Project, with the aim of strengthening the services of diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases, was initiated in 2018 under the financial facilities of the Japan International Cooperation Agency. Under the said project, it is expected to improve the cardiac treatment facilities at the National Hospital, Kandy the Teaching Hospitals of Anuradhapura, Kurunegala and Badulla and the Trincomalee District General Hospital. Bids have been invited in accordance with the provisions of the Loan Agreement and the procurement guidelines of the Japan International Cooperation Agency to select contractors for the construction of the New Cardiology Unit Building of the District General Hospital, Trincomalee under Package 01 of the said project and for the construction of the New Cardiology and Cardiothoracic Complex Building at the Teaching Hospital, Anuradhapura   under Package 03. Five (5) bids have been received for Package 01 and six (6) bids for Package 03. Based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, following the evaluation of the said bids, the Cabinet approved proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said contracts to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd as follows: PackageContract Value, Rs.
